device.description: Device path for the CD burner (e.g., /dev/sr0, /dev/cdrom)

speed.description: Write speed (0 = automatic detection; otherwise specify as multiplier of 1x = 176 KB/s, e.g., 4000 for ~4x)

buffer_size.description: CD writer buffer size in MB (larger buffers reduce underflow risk)

force_overwrite.description: Overwrite files in the ISO tree if they already exist

volume_label.description: Volume label for the ISO9660 filesystem (max 32 characters)

use_joliet.description: Include Joliet extensions for long filenames and Unicode support

use_rock_ridge.description: Include Rock Ridge extensions for Unix file attributes and symlinks

multisession.description: Enable multisession writing (allows adding more sessions later)

sources.description: List of files or directories to include in the CD image (paths may be absolute or relative)

items.description: Path to a file or directory to include in the ISO

iso_output.description: Path to write the ISO image before burning (leave empty to burn directly)

mode.description: Burn mode: 'disk-at-once' (DAO) for final sessions, 'track-at-once' (TAO) for incremental burns

pre_gap.description: Pre-gap length in frames (1 frame = 1/75 second); relevant for audio CDs only

audio_mode.description: Set to true to burn an audio CD (WAV/PCM sources only); false = data CD

eject.description: Eject the CD tray automatically after a successful burn

log_level.description: Verbosity of the burn log: quiet, normal, verbose, or debug
